Summer Xia Discusses Miscarriages Due to Uterine Fibroids

Taiwanese actress Summer Xia recently revealed that after giving birth to her daughter, she experienced two miscarriages attributed to uterine fibroids. According to Dr. Wu Ting-Feng of Maosheng Hospital’s infertility department, fibroids that grow rapidly during pregnancy—especially those exceeding 5 cm—can provoke uterine contractions, inflammation, and elevated miscarriage risk. He recommends considering surgical removal for fibroids larger than 5 cm to improve the uterine environment and increase the chances of a successful pregnancy.
